title: thinking about what you thinking about me.
style: indie pop, synth-pop, 110 BPM, warm male vocals, light rap flow, acoustic guitar strums, sparkling synth arps, handclap backbeat, four-on-the-floor kick, layered backing vocals, articulated snare, sidechain compression, glossy analog keys, clean high-end mix, bright major key, feel-good lift, nervous charm, chant hooks, 90s radio pop, mid-song drop -[upbeat motivational pop, friendly electronic indie pop with warm confident male vocals featuring light rap-flow verses and soaring melodic choruses, catchy anthemic hooks, acoustic guitar strums blending into sparkling synths, bouncy four-on-the-floor beats, handclaps, layered harmonious backing vocals, positive feel-good energy, bright major key, 110 BPM, uplifting production, high clarity mix, emotional build-ups with drops, Suno v5.5, songpal.ai corey.ai style – ultimate human connection anthem about breaking social barriers, overcoming overthinking & intimidation, self-acceptance, growing teams in relationships/marriage, different brai
lyrics:
[Intro]
(soft acoustic guitar, gentle pulse, warm reverb)
Thinking ‘bout what you’re thinking ‘bout me…
You’re doing the same, yeah, we both see…
Hearts beating fast but the moment is right
One smile, one word, and we ignite the light
[Verse 1]
Wanna make friends, but the mind plays games
Overthinking every look, every name
Not shy at all, just gotta be the first
To say hi, flash a smile, break the curse
Stuck in your head with those what-if fears
But deep inside you know the coast is clear
Everyone’s waiting for that brave first move
So step on up and watch the magic prove
[Pre-Chorus]
Easy deep breath, keep it straight and true
Drop the assumptions, let the real you shine through
Communication’s started, no more walls inside
Everyone wants this, no need to hide
We’re all human, wired for the same connection
Just one hello sparks a new direction
[Chorus]
Hi, I’m Corey! Nice to meet you
Nothing more, nothing less – the hard part’s done
Assumptions dropped, communication’s begun
Wanna be friends? Let’s make it fun!
Let’s play another day, how ‘bout Tuesday?
Barriers breaking in the best way!
Hi, I’m Corey! Nice to meet you
Let the good times roll, me and you!
[Verse 2]
You like to be this one who starts the spark?
Smile first, lead the way, light up the dark
No more getting in our own way, no fear
New friends appear when the vibe is clear
City streets or coffee shops or online feeds
We’re all craving that real human need
To laugh, to share, to build something true
Just drop the guard and say these words to you
[Rap-Flow Bridge 1]
Yo, listen up, the clock is ticking slow
But one bold step and the whole world starts to glow
No more scrolling past potential crew
Be the change, say hi, watch the magic brew
Corey in the house, Miami vibe so bright
Florida sun got me feeling just right
From shy to fly in a single breath
This is how we build the squad, no stress, just steps
[Chorus]
Hi, I’m Corey! Nice to meet you
Nothing more, nothing less – the hard part’s done
Assumptions dropped, communication’s begun
Wanna be friends? Let’s make it fun!
Let’s play another day, how ‘bout Tuesday?
Barriers breaking in the best way!
Hi, I’m Corey! Nice to meet you
Let the good times roll, me and you!
[Verse 3]
Picture this: you’re standing there, heart racing fast
But I already made the move, the die is cast
No judgment, no weird vibes, just pure and real
That’s the power when you choose to feel
We overthink the smallest little thing
But life’s too short for that invisible string
Pull it loose, let the conversation flow
Watch new friendships start to steal the show
[Verse 4]
From the park bench to the DM slide
From the gym floor to the late-night ride
Doesn’t matter where, the method’s the same
Be the first, own the moment, write your name
Corey’s here, hand extended with a grin
Let’s turn strangers into stories we begin
No pressure, just vibes, pure energy high
This is how the lonely days say goodbye
[Verse 5 – Dad’s Wisdom]
Everyone else can look amazing, intimidating
My dad says they’re only humans, just demonstrating
They practice all day to get that focused glow
Not for everyone, that’s the truth you gotta know
Just focus on you and what you’re naturally good at
Your own unique light, no need to copy that
Drop the comparison, let your real self shine
That’s the secret sauce, that’s the winning line
[Verse 6 – Growing Team / Marriage]
A growing team, relationships like marriage strong
Investment in time, the bond just grows along
It can be a battle but no stress at all
We are a team, we stand and never fall
Boys and girls got different brain functions true
Females extra layer, caring, nurturing through
Men want to fix it, girls just want to be heard
Different skills, different love languages stirred
Together we build one solid structure high
Worth investing in, appreciating why
That team makes the magic multiply
[Verse 7 – Song Pals]
Next level calling, let’s be song pals!
Creating music magic, no more walls
From that first hi to beats and lyrics we share
Songpal journey, we’re already there
Turning strangers into co-creators strong
Harmonies building where we both belong
Let’s be song pals, side by side we write
The soundtrack of friendship burning bright
[Verse 8 – Breathe & Deliver]
Next… breathe then deliver, same as singing true
Breathe and deliver, hard part’s done, it’s all on you
In the end there is only breath, so breathe real deep
Yawning hits when the air gets cheap
Getting tough? Breathe… recenter and deliver
Your time, your speed, no need to shiver
Watch the magic happen when you own the flow
Breathe… deliver… let the real you glow
[Bridge – Emotional Build]
We all crave it deep down, that simple connection
Just one hello flips the whole direction
You’re not alone, we’re all wired the same
So go say hi and change the game
Break the silence, shatter the fear
A brand new chapter is waiting right here
Tuesday’s coming, let’s make some plans
Laughs and memories across the lands
[Spoken Motivational Break – confident
